cookie.title: Site cookie profiles
cookie.description: Import once to detect video sites automatically. Downloads use the matching site cookies without per-site setup.
cookie.pastePlaceholder: Paste raw cookie string, e.g. SESSDATA=xxx; bili_jct=yyy
cookie.errNoYtdlp: Browser extraction requires the yt-dlp engine to be installed
cookie.errBrowserPermission: Can't read browser cookies (system permission). Grant this app Full Disk Access in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then retry; or import a cookies.txt file instead
cookie.errBrowserNotFound: {{browser}} not detected (not installed or no signed-in data). Pick an installed, signed-in browser, or import a cookies.txt file instead
cookie.riskNote: Bulk downloading with account cookies may trigger platform anti-abuse; use with caution
cookie.maybeExpiredHint: The site rejected the request; check login status or downloader compatibility
cookie.supportedSitesHint: Existing custom sites are also recognized. Cookies for other websites are not saved. Add unlisted download sites in manual management.
cookie.batchResultHint: Ignored {{count}} unrelated cookies. Matching sites were replaced; sites not found retain their previous cookies.
cookie.validityHint: Imported cookies do not confirm login or download availability. Validity has not been verified.
cookie.empty: No sites imported yet. Choose a signed-in browser or import a cookies.txt file.
cookie.errNoSupportedSites: No supported-site cookies were found. Existing data was kept. Check the signed-in browser profile, or add another site in manual management.
cookie.errNoValidCookies: No valid cookies were read. Existing data was kept. Check the browser profile or use a Netscape-format cookies.txt file.
cookie.errDecrypt: Browser cookies could not be decrypted. Existing data was kept. Complete system authorization or import an exported cookies.txt file.
cookie.errProfileMissing: The selected browser profile no longer exists. Reopen this dialog and select a profile.
cookie.errProfileList: Could not list browser profiles. Check system permissions or import a cookies.txt file.
cookie.errDelete: Could not delete cookies. Check local storage and try again.
